name: Sheet-Pan Smoked Sausage, Broccoli and Cheddar
why: Best-in-band of every sausage dish I could verify this pass: 472 cal (mid-band), 10.6g total carbs (net 6.6g, far under the 35g ceiling), and 24.7g protein - the only sausage-forward option that reaches the 25g protein ideal, since veg-heavy sausage skillets/bakes kept coming in UNDER the 400-cal floor (zucchini pizza boats 157, cheesy cabbage casserole 333) or landing at 16-20g protein. A dry-roasted sheet pan of sausage + broccoli + cheddar - no cream cheese or mayo - so it is a different dish and method from the creamy broccoli-smoked-sausage cream-cheese casseroles already in the pool (thatlowcarblife, captured x3); flagging that near-dup relationship honestly for the adjudicators. Meat + cheese + non-starchy vegetable, zero starch base. Scales cleanly to 14 across sheet pans, weigh-and-divide friendly. Andouille has no exact board home (flagged for the pricer-lane exercise) but rebuilds cleanly on kielbasa or smoked-turkey-sausage, both already on the board.
confidence: high on the numbers - read nutrition and full ingredient list off the source page. Medium on novelty - it is broccoli+sausage, a combo already represented as creamy bakes in the pool; different method/dish but the decider may still rule it a near-dup.
